name: Lampstand
overview: The lampstand, crafted of pure beaten gold with detailed shafts, branches, bowls, knops, and flowers, was a divinely appointed fixture in the tabernacle, as described in Exodus 25:31 and 37:17. God instructed Moses to command the Israelites to provide pure olive oil to keep the lamps burning continually, symbolizing a perpetual light before the LORD (Leviticus 24:1-4). This continual illumination on the pure candlestick underscores God's desire for His presence to be visibly manifest and enduring among His people, as further emphasized in Numbers 8:1.
